messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx + timeouts detected in prod-west. p95 latency jumped from ~890ms -> 2.1s, p99 from ~1.6s -> 6.4s in the last 3m. 5xx rate up ~6%. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Deploy: deploy-20260315-1427. Pager: Sam (oncall).
Sam (oncall): on it. tagging SRE + runtime eng. Sam: anyone on the deploy?
DeployBot: deploy-20260315-1427 rollout -> prod-west finished at 2167887600, image: rwd-infer/runtime:v1.45-quant-opt, rollout %: 100%.
Anna (dev): I shipped PR #8274 earlier — quantization kernel change + batching tweak to reduce memory. Rollout was green in canary but small canary traffic.
Mike SRE: looking at graphs now. connection_queue length spiked, worker threads entering BACKOFF, KV cache miss ratio up 8x. Logs show repeated RPC timeouts to runtime-worker: 
```
2026-03-15T02:49:13Z runtime-worker-23 ERROR request_handler.cpp:245 request timeout after 12000ms
2026-03-15T02:49:13Z runtime-worker-23 WARN kv_cache.cpp:88 eviction flood, pending_writes=312
```
Sam (oncall): @Mike good signal. Can we scope: total customer impact? percent of requests failing?
Mike SRE: 5xx spike concentrated on requests with long context (>1024 tokens). Error-rate on /v1/generate ~5.8% globally, prod-west ~9% for long-context routes. Short-context OK.
Zoe (eng): that aligns with the quantization change — likely regression at larger seq lengths. Anna, any fast rollback path?
Anna (dev): yes — we have previous runtime image rwd-infer/runtime:v1.44-stable. Recommend immediate rollback of prod-west and route traffic to prod-east if needed.
Sam (oncall): decision: do immediate rollback for prod-west to v1.44. Lia, prep customer comms for impacted orgs (long context customers) and add note for degraded throughput. I'll execute rollback after SRE confirms.
Lia (support): on it — drafting short status: "We detected increased timeouts affecting long-context requests in prod-west after a routine runtime update. We're rolling back and will post updates every 30m." Will tag customers on watchlist.
Mike SRE: performing quick mitigation checks — can we also reduce max_seq on the gateway for prod-west as a safety net? We can set seq cap to 1024 to reduce exposure while rollback proceeds.
Zoe (eng): good idea. I'll apply a soft cap via feature-flag on the gateway for prod-west: `seq_cap=1024` (non-destructive).
Sam (oncall): executing rollback now. Command: 
```
# rollback to previous stable image in prod-west
rdctl deploy rollback --cluster prod-west --service runtime --to-image rwd-infer/runtime:v1.44-stable --reason "p99/timeouts after v1.45" --by sam
```
DeployBot: rollback job started: job_id rb-20260315-01. 4 nodes draining and pulling v1.44-stable. Estimated 4m to steady.
IncidentBot: Auto-mitigation: traffic rebalancer initiating gradual shift away from prod-west -> prod-east for 10% of traffic to reduce customer impact.
Mike SRE: KV cache warmup script running to restore working set on new pods:
```
# warmup
for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -s "http://localhost:8080/_warm?seed=$i" >/dev/null; done
```
DeployBot: rollback completed on prod-west at 2167890960. All runtime nodes now at rwd-infer/runtime:v1.44-stable. Health checks passing.
Sam (oncall): monitoring. initial telemetry shows p95 back to ~930ms, p99 dropping to ~1.7s, 5xx trending down. Continuing 30m watch.
Anna (dev): I'll open a rollback-root-cause PR with reproducer (long-context + quant kernels) and pin the quantization change for further perf testing.
Lia (support): posted update to customers at 02:52 UTC. Notifying affected accounts and adding them to high-touch list.
Mike SRE: follow-ups: collect heap profiles from v1.45 pods (if any left), compare kernel paths, and run stressbench on long-context jobs. Also set alert threshold lower to catch similar regressions earlier.
Zoe (eng): I'll temporarily add a regression check in the CI smoke that runs 10x long-context samples against runtime v1.45 candidate builds.
Sam (oncall): incident status: mitigation (rollback) applied and success. Impact: elevated timeouts for long-context requests in prod-west for ~6-12 minutes, customer-visible errors for some orgs. Root cause suspected quantization kernel regression under large sequence lengths in v1.45.
Sam (oncall): moving to post-incident handoff. @Mike please drive RCA doc, @Anna follow up on PR/QA, @Zoe add CI coverage, @Lia continue customer comms. I'll hand off monitoring to L2 for overnight watch.
Mike SRE: acknowledged. creating incident ticket INC-20260315-0427 with action items.
IncidentBot: Incident declared MONITORED → RESOLVED if no regression within 30m. Next update scheduled at +30m.
Sam (oncall): handoff complete. signing off for now. :white_check_mark:
